header.description: Vocabulary-disjoint paraphrases used to tune the hybrid-search candidates. Each is written from the problem a target document solves, then checked with the real lexical tokenizer: no content term of the paraphrase appears in the target title, tags, module, symptoms, applies_when, component, problem type or body. Brainstorm targets are left out because docs/brainstorms/ is untracked, so this file holds committed kinds only. A paraphrase is a tuning input, never a mined need.
header.disjointness_checked_against: the corpus at 32e2097f plus 60 untracked brainstorms

fields.id: opaque q-tNNN id; the number is the paraphrase's position in the full tune split before brainstorm targets were left out
fields.target: repo-relative path of the one labeled document
fields.paraphrase: the information need, in words that do not appear in the target
